content.title: Here's where to watch and stream UConn vs. Michigan: HBO Max, Sling TV
content.text: INDIANAPOLIS, INDIANA - APRIL 06: Head coach Dan Hurley of the UConn Huskies reacts during the first half of a game against the Michigan Wolverines in the National Championship of the 2026 NCAA Men's Basketball Tournament at Lucas Oil Stadium on April 06, 2026 in Indianapolis, Indiana. (Photo by Patrick Smith/Getty Images)Patrick Smith/Getty ImagesThe UConn Huskies are taking on the University of Michigan Wolverines for the men's college basketball national championship in Indianapolis on Monday.For Dan Hurley's Huskies, the game is an opportunity to win a third title in four years and cement the program as a modern hoops dynasty. Michigan, frequently the bridesmaid in March Madness, is looking to win its first title since 1989, the only in program history.Article continues below this adGet Digital Access and Stay Informed With Trusted Local News.Get Digital Access and Stay Informed With Trusted Local News.ONLY 25¢Here's where to watch and stream the UConn vs. Michigan national championship game.Where to watch UConn Michigan gameOn television, the UConn vs. Michigan national championship game is airing on TBS, TNT and TruTV. The exact channel depends on the viewer's local listings.How to stream UConn Michigan gameThe UConn vs. Michigan national championship game is available on a variety of streaming services, including HBO Max, Sling TV, DirecTV Stream, YouTube TV and Hulu + Live TV.Article continues below this adThe game is available for viewers with an HBO Max Standard plan. For cord-cutters hoping to catch the game on a budget, Sling TV offers a $4.99 "Day Pass, which provides access to both TBS and TNT, which are airing the game.What time does UConn Michigan game startThe UConn vs. Michigan national championship game tipped off at 8:52 p.m. Eastern on Monday night, shortly after its scheduled start time of 8:50 p.m.Article continues below this adGet daily updates from the UConn basketball world.
